proof:
ext x
  rw [h₀]
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hf : (x + 14) * (x - 8) = 0 := by nlinarith [hx]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h | h
    · left; linarith
    · right; linarith
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num

have hn : (2 - Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  have hr := congrArg Complex.re hz
  norm_num at hr
apply (eq_div_iff hn).2
rw [← h₂, ← h₀, h₁]

have hx : x ^ 4 = 5 * x ^ 2 - 6 := by
  simpa only [h₀, h₁] using h₂
have hy : y ^ 4 = 5 * y ^ 2 - 6 := by
  simpa only [h₀, h₁] using h₃
have hf : (y ^ 2 - x ^ 2) * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 - 5) = 0 := by
  nlinarith [hx, hy]
rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h | h
· linarith
· linarith

have hs : 0 < x + y + z := by positivity
  have hxy : 0 < x + y := by positivity
  have hp : 0 ≤ (x + y - 2 * z) ^ 2 /
      (2 * (x + y) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) := by positivity
  have heq : (x + y - 2 * z) ^ 2 /
      (2 * (x + y) * (x + y + z) ^ 2) =
      2 / (x + y) - 6 / (x + y + z) +
        (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (x + y) / (x + y + z) ^ 2 := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hxy, ne_of_gt hs] <;> ring
  rw [← heq]
  exact hp

have hle : n ≤ m := by
    by_contra h
    have h' : m ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h)
    have hz : m - n = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h'
    rw [h₂] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  have hcancel := Nat.sub_add_cancel hle
  rw [h₂] at hcancel
  linarith

have ha : (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt h₀.2)
  field_simp [ha] at h₁
  linarith
